Notes: THE HEAD COACH STOPS THE MATCH TO EXPLAIN (round AN, your note). One row = one interruption. MODE: the MatchModes.csv row it belongs to (intro = the first match, intro2 = the second; blank = any match). WHEN: the moment, one of kick_off, duel_won, duel_lost, shot_taken, goal_scored, goal_conceded, save_made, keeper_emptied, foul_given, card_yellow, card_red, free_kick_won, star_switch, play_maker. REQUIRES: the usual condition language (flag:x, count:goals>=1). SCENE: a scene in Dialogue.csv - its lines play in a box over the pitch while the match waits, with the speaker's face from StoryArt.csv. ONCE: true = only the first time ever. Write the scene first; a row whose scene does not exist is skipped and named in the Output panel.
